input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Apple's Services net sales for the quarter ended March 28, 2026 grew by more than 10% year over year. Evidence E1 provides a table showing Services net sales for the three months ended March 28, 2026 was $30,976 million compared to $26,645 million for the three months ended March 29, 2025, with a change of 16%. Since 16% > 10%, the claim is supported. The calculation confirms: (30,976 - 26,645) / 26,645 = 0.1626 or 16.26%, which is indeed more than 10%.
